'''Control Another's Disease''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] which allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual to control the spread of a [[Disease/Legends|disease]] in another. The method was similar to the [[Control Disease|ability]] that allowed the Force user to control disease within their own body. The process was made easier by the relationship between the two individuals, and the proximity between them.<ref name="RPG" />
